recognize_zh: 四格周邊血中可見核濃縮成深紫色團塊、染色質碎裂、細胞質皺縮的凋亡淋巴球（apoptotic lymphocytes），以及一顆細胞質深藍、有空泡的反應性淋巴球；年輕人發燒咽喉痛時看到這些細胞，應聯想傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Apoptotic lymphocytes with shrunken cells and condensed, pyknotic or fragmented dark nuclear chromatin
Apoptotic cells show irregular, retracted cytoplasm with blebbing
One reactive lymphocyte with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm (top left)
Small dense round nucleus in a compact cell (top right) consistent with early apoptosis
Background red cells normocytic; occasional platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several apoptotic lymphocytes characterized by cell shrinkage, condensed pyknotic nuclei with chromatin fragmentation, and irregular retracted cytoplasm. A reactive lymphocyte with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm is also present. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Increased circulating apoptotic lymphocytes accompanying reactive lymphocytes are a recognized clue to acute viral infection and, in a young adult with fever and pharyngitis, are suggestive of infectious mononucleosis; heterophile antibody and EBV serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Orthochromatic normoblasts have a single round dense nucleus in pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not grey-blue lymphoid cytoplasm with nuclear fragments.

ddx.dx: Smudge cells of chronic lymphocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: Smudge cells are crushed nuclei without cytoplasm, whereas apoptotic cells retain a cytoplasmic rim around condensed nuclear fragments.
Aged EDTA samples show diffuse degenerative changes in many leukocyte types, including neutrophils, rather than selective apoptotic lymphocytes with reactive forms.
Neoplastic cells have intact nuclei with fine or open chromatin and nucleoli, not pyknosis and karyorrhexis.
